title: Flood, Nigeria, 1 June 2025 (FL20250601NGA)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Flood, Nigeria, 1 June 2025 (FL20250601NGA), from 2 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: FL20250601NGA, GDACS ID: 1103303**  This map illustrates the satellite-detected water extent in Mokwa Town, Niger Local Government Area, Niger State, Nigeria as observed from a GeoEye-1 imagery acquired on 2 June 2025 at 11:24 local time. Within the analysed area of approximately 100 km², an estimated 1.5 km² of land appears to be affected by floodwaters. UNOSAT has identified within this area 470 damaged structures and 199 potentially affected structures. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
